_readme: Every fact about the practice lives in this file, and only here. _sources says where each came from.

A value written as { "placeholder": ..., "needs": ... } is not known yet. The site shows it as a marked placeholder, and `npm run build:strict` (the publishing workflow) refuses to build while any remain. Prefer leaving an unknown fact out of the pages, and listing it under _dropped.
Run `npm run build` afterwards: it rebuilds the site and regenerates PLACEHOLDERS.md.

_sources.mentor.*, offer.freeSessions: Nick's own words, his order of 19 October 2026: he has mentored students and young adults for five years; though he is young, that has played to his advantage, because he has seen many people go through tech addiction and has been able to get them out of it; a 100% satisfaction rate across 23 clients; the first five sessions are free, as a diagnostic.
_sources.mentor.legalName: The name on his own Google account.
_sources.site.url: deepestrest.com, registered on Nick's Cloudflare account and served by GitHub Pages.
_sources.practice.email: hello@deepestrest.com, a Cloudflare Email Routing address on his domain that forwards to his Gmail.
_sources.calendly.url: The Calendly account in his name (Google sign-in), event 'Free diagnostic session'.
